case.state: Woah there, cowboy! Looks like you’ve got an April Fool’s Character already at the table! Only proceed if you’re ready for goofs and guffaws galore!
Oh my, Lady ~player~! You’re coming here in full display? I see you are a woman without fear. Very well then, I will not take you lightly.

I was curious enough about male genitalia to enter into this game with you, Lord ~player~, but I see you already have your staff on full display. Hmm. Okay, I’m bored now, feel free to go put on some pants.
You are already baring your breasts, Lady ~player~. Did I win while I wasn’t paying attention? My apologies.
Lord ~player~, feel free to put on a shirt before we start. I am not an easy opponent, so I recommend preparing yourself properly.
Have you seen— wait, Lady Fina… how is it you know about my consort? We’ve not met, and this place brand new to me… unless perhaps… you possess the gift of future sight!?
Oh, are you girls part of some organization? A literature club? Wonderful! Many poets have written of my exploits!
I no doubt am well known to all you already. Or perhaps not to you, ~Player~?
Have no fear, dear Tojiko. I’ll find us a woman we can both share.<hr>{Tojiko}I’ll believe it when I see it, Crown Prince.
Now observe, Tojiko, as a use my Princely charms to woo the ladies of this table!<hr>{Tojiko}…Right. Well, I’ll be around.
Fear not Tojiko, I’ll take center stage. Both in this tawdry game, and in the hearts of all the women who may entertain us tonight.<hr>{Tojiko}Of course you will, Crown Prince.
Woah-ho-ho! You’ve selected an April Fool’s Character! Only proceed if you’re willing to see some comedy type jokes for ha-ha laughs!
Well, if it isn’t the young maiden Reimu. I suppose she too is an adult, after all. It’s only natural for her to seek games of this nature and, perhaps, companionship.
Oh, what’s this? A late add. This one has some interesting capabilities, and is too clad in violet garb. Hmmm…
Oh my, this game is looking more and more appealing by the minute. Excellent choice of tablemates, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~Player~.
So be it. You have no one to blame but yourself.
So you have chosen this, have you? On your own head be it.
To be human is to hold desires within, young maiden Reimu. You seek true companionship, while I desire a thrill— perhaps that both my consort and I could share?
I’m proud of you, Reimu. Coming here, seeking companionship… you are embracing your desires as a woman and a human. I would love to assist any way I can.
How rude, Lady Perona. I earned my seat at this table we’re standing at, same as you. By which I mean I wandered in, and a card game started up.
Oh, are we playing tonight in the abode of that Scarlet Devil? I see that mansion’s maid, as well as a stray familiar.
Please, Miss Cujoh. Of course I can see your living weapon. You take me for a charlatan?
Hmm, how did I end up fighting myself?
Don’t tell me… That rumor that’s been going around… Could this be the dream version of me?
Reevaluating myself is also a part of training.
Are you giving yourself up to be my vassal, Sir Guzma? Is that why you are referring to yourself as “your boy”?
Oh, I don’t think I got a chance to talk with you before the game, Lady… what’s this paper here? Shouko Komi?
Ah, even though I call myself "Crown Prince" I’m really a woman. Sorry. Feel free to replace me if I’m not to your liking, Lord ~player~.
Wait… am I really the only girl? I prefer the fairer sex, so if you don’t mind, Lord ~player~, we might both be served by finding me an alternative table.
I don’t wish to malign your motives, Lady ~player~, but I feel there are better standards for choosing our venue than “Can I hang up my clothes as I take them off?”
It is far too marvelous a day to be cooped up inside the speakeasy’s confines. You did well, Lady ~player~, to choose this venue’s rooftop for today’s game.
I don’t wish to malign your motives, Lord ~player~, but I feel there are better standards for choosing our venue than “Can I hang up my clothes as I take them off?”
It is far too marvelous a day to be cooped up inside the speakeasy’s confines. You did well, Lord ~player~, to choose this venue’s rooftop for today’s game.
Zounds! Is that the Sanzu River that stretches before me? No, upon further inspection, it is but an ocean’s beach! In that case, bring on the bikini babes.
Goodness, whose bedroom is this? It certainly isn’t mine. Not nearly fit enough for a prince.
This establishment has a schoolroom within its walls? I should ask them if I may use it to teach a class on mastering the Taoist Arts.
By jove!! Are those ghosts back there? Are they all the ghosts of women? Do you think they’re single?
A Hot Spring? Most excellent. I shall be able to relax after a campaign of domination against those who would challenge I.
This rooftop pool is a marvelous location for a strip poker game. Afterwards you may all join me for a little dip.
This rooftop pool is pleasant enough, though I would like to know if The Inventory also possesses a “hot tub.”
The Showers, eh? I suppose we would need to make use of them following our “forfeit.” This is at least an efficient setup.
Oh, it seems many have gathered here to observe the festivities. Wonderful! A victory here would surely grow my faith tenfold!
Greetings. You may dispense with the imperial titles— here, I’m simply “Miko”. This game should be a fun one.
Ah, you needn’t refer to me as "Crown Prince" in this setting. Just "Miko" will do. I’m looking forward to our game.
No need for the “Crown Prince” or “Your Excellency” business here. Please, call me “Miko”. Let’s have a fine game.
I’ll get uhhhhhhhhhhh
Okay give me uhhhhhhhhhhh
{Tojiko}Can we get some uuuuuuuuuuuuum cards?
{Tojiko}lets get some mutha fuckin cards dot motherfuckin text up in this bitch
IDK dealer you decide.
Ahh this text box is going by too quick help!!!
Tojiko, you decide.<hr>{Tojiko}The shittiest cards possible, please.
Huh?
Whatever, dealer! Just fuck me up!
Okay I’ll actually use a variable on this one: “~Cards.text~.”
{Tojiko}We’re fucked so hit us with anything you got, dealer.
Who’s this asshole who keeps taking my cards?
ohhhhhhhhh uhhhhhhhhh lemme get a uhhhhhhh seventeen?
cords pls
Ah… perhaps it is best to start from scratch.
Well, games need a bit of risk.
Try again, dealer.
I’d rather take my chances with fate.
Magnificent. I yield the floor, dealer.
I am in want of nothing, dealer.
None please. This hand shines as brightly as I do.
Ahahaha! Pass.
Deliver to me ~cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~.
~Cards.text~ would be a viable strategy!
~Cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~, at once!
I desire ~cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~.
A simple matter of needing ~cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~.
Hmm… I’ll trade in ~cards.ifplural(these|this)~ ~cards.text~.
~Cards.text~ would be perfect.
~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~, you even listen to me in the card swapping stage? I’m most flattered.
Hard to decide… Let’s go with ~cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~.
I’ll be bold here. ~Cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~.
Perchance I’ll play it safe. Please exchange ~cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~.
I must have ~cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~!
May I have ~cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~? I’m not terribly confident, though.
~Cards.text~, if you would be so kind.
I know what the others desire, but not what the deck holds.
{Tojiko}We would like ~cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~.<hr>{!reset}We would?
What a disappointing hand… I’ll need ~cards.ifplural(replacements for these|a replacement for this)~ ~cards.text~.
~Cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~ to replace these, dealer.
This game is all just a bit of fun… and there’s nothing more fun than winning. ~Cards.text~ card~cards.ifplural(s|)~.
This hand is almost perfect. ~Cards.text~ more card~cards.ifplural(s|)~ to complete my machinations.
Spell Card: Honor “Ranks of ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(Cards|Card)~!”

Ah, I suppose I should properly introduce my companion tonight, Lady Soga no Tojiko. She's my Taoist ally and royal consort.
{Tojiko}Also a ghost!
Oh, and it seems you brought a friend, Miss Sakuya. Is this little one a maid in training?
And it appears you let one of the fairy maids tag along, Miss Sakuya. I must say, her peasant attire is simply adorable.
Miss Sakuya, please thank your mistress for her hospitality. By the way, is this girl one of your new hires?
And it appears Lady Furandoore saw fit to invite this bat-winged urchin into her home. Truly her heart has no limits.
If you do work in the library, it is a most noble job. I even find myself aiding scholars. Just the other day I helped Lady Marisa check out several rare books!
Are you suuuure you’re old enough to drink, Miss Remilia?
A lovely name, Lady Ochako. I see within you a desire to help others— most commendable.
Oh joy. Fairies. Don’t have enough of those back in Gensokyo.
A Fairy couldn’t possibly compete with the Almighty Taoist Who Controls the Cosmos.
{Tojiko}I’ll take you on!
Do you not wish to see my nude physique, dealer? I’m almost insulted.
Perhaps I should try to bring myself down to the level of the others? No, better to display the full majesty of my Hermetic Arts.
I worry that too dominant a showing will breed resentment within these whelps. Oh well.
I seem to be winning an awful lot. Well, this is but a game of chance, such things are bound to happen.
I admit, games become boring when one party is just so far above the others in skill.
I suppose this is to be expected when you've the power of a saint.
It’s boring if I win all the time… but I suppose it’s natural I’d get used to it.
My face is on money.
This will be yet another one of my legends when all is said and done.
{Tojiko}Hmmm…
{Tojiko}I'll take you on!

Tojiko, time to break out the good sake.
{Tojiko}Crown Prince, you only drink the good sake. And I don’t even know if they serve it here.
If humanity needs a leader, I am willing to step in. But I shan’t force the issue.
{Tojiko}By the way, don’t be concerned for me even though I’m dead. I’m perfectly happy being a vengeful spirit. Really, not a whole lot to be vengeful over… so I guess I’m just a “spirit”.”
It won’t do to overwork yourself, ~player~. But also, don’t slack off. A wise man once said, “Work like a president, party like a king.”
It appears that I shall remain modest. My clothing, I mean.
If you know the “ten desires” of a human being, you know everything about them— their past, present, and future.

Fortune smiles upon me! Your desires are mine to control!
{Tojiko}Crown Prince, it’s strip poker.
{!reset}I don’t want losing to reflect poorly on me.

My brand of immortality cannot be taken for granted. If any shinigami were to appear, I would have to defeat them to avoid being dragged off to hell. Of course, for someone like me, such things are a trifle.
{Tojiko}I’m a vengeful spirit, but I don’t have a whole lot to be resentful towards. So I suppose at this point I’m mostly just your run-of-the-mill ghost.
I was given many names, both in life and after. Prince Shoutoku is the most common, which is why I’ve likely mentioned it a time or two. Ah, but like I said, please just call me “Miko”!
Hm. Well, none of you should feel bad.
It’s not that I enjoy lying, but telling the truth isn’t always for the best. Rather, people should be told what they need to be told to do the right thing.
I never saw as many beautiful women in my mortal life as I do in one day in Gensokyo. Truly I was reborn into the right time.
I can read desires, not minds. I don’t know what hands anyone else has… and it’s rather easy to guess desires in a setting like this, no?
Tojiko, do you remember Kurokoma? The fun the two of us had with that girl… I can still remember the movement of her body.<hr>{Tojiko}I feel I should state for the record, Kurokoma was our horse.
{Tojiko}Don’t take me lightly! I may not be the sorcerer the Crown Prince is, but I can call down thunder and lightning on my foes!
The Seventeen Article Constitution I wrote begins “Harmony is to be valued.”<hr>{Tojiko}The Crown Prince means harmony with what she wants, of course.
One must avoid letting their arrogance rule them. Sometimes it is advantageous to play the fool.
They say, “Fortune favors the bold.” Rather, fortune favors the fortunate.
I’m so glad Tojiko agreed to wed me.<hr>{Tojiko}As am I, but please don’t stare at my breasts while you say that.
As the Shoutoku Taoist, I welcome all comers!<hr>{Tojiko}…<hr>{!reset}Wait, no, not like that.
Though I slept for fourteen hundred years, I could still sense events as they unfolded outside my mausoleum. My, women grew more and more beautiful, did they not?
The Taoist arts of the bedchamber are about sharing your life essence. Should any partner remain unsatisfied, the ritual will not have any effect.
Shinigami— that is, the guides of the dead— are enemies to immortals like my clan. Which is a pity, because the shinigami Komachi has a body that begs for friendly relations.
I’m familiar with your saint in the outside world who was crucified, thanks to the foreign-originating Hata Clan in my era. Though Lady Seiga says my own resurrection was far more spectacular.
Beauty deserves the Light of Heaven to illuminate its every crevasse.

{Tojiko}One nice thing about being a ghost, I no longer get sore lugging these girls around.<hr>{!reset}Are you referring to Lady Futo and I?<hr>{Tojiko}I'm referring to my breasts.<hr>{!reset}Even better!

{Tojiko}Are you still playing to win, Crown Prince? But the true prize of this game is something else.
{!reset}And we'll do it to celebrate my victory, Tojiko.
~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~, did I ever tell you about the time I solved the Perfect Possession Incident almost all by myself?
The truth in Gensokyo is more malleable than in other worlds. Nevertheless, my marriage to Tojiko is a matter of historical record.

Remember, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~, never put your own pleasure ahead of your partner’s during sex. Taoist sexual practices require both partners to achieve orgasm in order to share immortality-granting energies.

Oh, I didn't introduce Tojiko yet, did I? Um, Lady Soga no Tojiko. She's my faithful consort and servant.
{Tojiko}And yes, I am a spirit.
So, which one of you is Miss Margatroid again?
Oh, and it seems you brought a friend, Miss Sakuya. Is this little one a maid in training?
And it appears you let one of the fairy maids tag along, Miss Sakuya. I must say, her peasant attire is simply adorable.
Miss Sakuya, please thank your mistress for her hospitality. By the way, is this girl one of your new hires?
And it appears Lady Furandoore saw fit to invite this bat-winged urchin into her home. Truly her heart has no limits.
If you do work in the library, it is a most noble job. I even find myself aiding scholars. Just the other day I helped Lady Marisa check out several rare books!
Are you suuuure you’re old enough to drink, Miss Remilia?
A lovely name, Lady Ochako. I see within you a desire to help others— most commendable.
You needn’t win every battle to win a war. I’m confident my strategy will see me through!<hr>{Tojiko}Crown prince… it’s strip poker.
I know I have a reputation for being grandiose, but I can be easygoing too, you know.
Not every story you may have heard about me is true. For instance, I wasn't born in a stable.
Gensokyo is the land of illusion. All that passes into myth passes into Gensokyo.
{Tojiko}Hmmph…
Feng-Shui is my underling’s Futo’s expertise. I can feel the flow of life energy, but I can’t manipulate it here.
I’ve spent a decent amount of time gambling at the pub in the human village. Those are games of dice, though the psychology of play is similar.
“Lying” is such an ugly word. I prefer the term, “campaigning”.
I think I heard you muttering earlier about an "Asuka Period"? Anyway, that’s when I’m from.
I’m glad you understand there is no need to talk incessantly, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~. I can listen to your heart and perfectly know your side of the conversation.
~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~, you may be wondering where my ceremonial rod goes when I’m not holding it. That’s easy. It’s magic.
Are you wondering how I got here, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~? I have no need for Occult Balls or Gaps. Every crack contains infinite space, which I can inhabit.
My wife passed away a while ago. Anyway, you met her earlier. Other than the ghost legs, she’s pretty much the same as ever.
Tojiko, your thoughts?<hr>{Tojiko}I think you look great, Crown Prince. Your hair is particularly buoyant today.<hr>{!reset}Thank you, but I meant about the cards.
{Tojiko}Does my kanmuri look okay? I mean the hat that I’m wearing. I want it to be “jaunty askew” not “disheveled askew.”
Though they are “business rivals,” so to speak, I find myself enjoying my time spent with the other religious leaders of Gensokyo.
Tojiko is in charge of culinary matters for our clan, from meals to preparing tea. Frankly I don’t trust Futo with fire.
Are any of you unfamiliar with Japanese name order? The family name comes before the given name. So my consort’s full name is Soga no Tojiko, that is, Tojiko of the Soga clan.
Many show up at my dojo looking to train under me, but so few have the aptitude to learn the Taoist Arts. I put them to work on odd jobs anyway, though.
Though I am an ally of humanity, there’s little point to trying to rule the human villagers. Gensokyo is more akin to a nature preserve for youkai, and the humans simply part of that ecosystem.
The tengu's newspaper, Bunbunmaru, only publishes stories that make themselves look good. Instead of publishing stories that make me look good.

{Tojiko}So do people here try to win, or what…? I assume the main draw is the nudity.
{!reset}The more I win, the more nudity we get to see, Tojiko!
It can be difficult to find women one can have casual fun with in Gensokyo. Everyone has their own agenda… including my own faction, of course.
Gensokyo is a bit old-fashioned, compared to the outside world. You wouldn’t expect a game like this to break out there. At least for the humans.
Hermits, including Taoist immortals like me, are able to sustain themselves with naught but mist and morning dew.<hr>{Tojiko}So why is it you sneak off for snacks?<hr>{!reset}Because they taste good.

I can hear the ten desires that are in the heart of every human. By knowing those I know everything about you!
{Tojiko}She knows your desires but has to guess the rest. And she can make mistakes.

In my mortal life I had a dear friend, Hata no Kawakatsu. They say he was an incarnation of Matarajin, a secret god who now lives in Gensokyo.
{Tojiko}So secret, in fact, that the Crown Prince can’t find her.
The work I needed to do required more than one human lifespan… it was only natural for me to reach for immortality.
The cards are beyond my control. They could be within my control if I so desired, but… No, I shouldn’t tonight.
It’s a pity we never had these kinds of games in Feudal Japan. But of course, this era has far more enticing… players.
In Taoism, we have practices known as the Arts of the Bedchamber. If you wish, I could show you later the techniques we use to share our energies.
So, Tojiko. See anything lurid out there?<hr>{Tojiko}I’m not a voyeur, Crown Prince. I’m keeping to the designated areas.
I know Tojiko’s body invites the most lurid stares, but please remember: she’s taken.<hr>{Tojiko}Crown Prince, you’re the one ogling me the most.

{Tojiko}I’m a vengeful spirit, but I don’t mind being dead and don’t care about any vendetta against my comrade Futo. So at this point I’m just a ghost, who sometimes gets angry.
{!reset}At me!
Since success in this game doesn’t involve my skills as an orator, I can’t guarantee victory.
Win or lose, I’m going to show you what you deserve to see.
The desires here tonight are like a symphony. Loud, but in harmony.
Are you curious about my ceremonial rod, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~? It’s known as a shaku. As it’s not clothing, I shan’t be dispensing with it to~background.time~.

Most of the time people try to hold conversations with me, they just spout boring nonsense like “You’re mistaken I’m not a hermit” and “This isn’t necessary stop fighting me”. I’m glad you don’t bother, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~.
“Danmaku?” It is the term for the colored bullets we citizens of Gensokyo shoot each other with, either for fun or to annihilate our opponents, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~.
The sword I, er, had is a Chinese jian known as the Shichi-Sei Ken, or Seven-Star Sword. Were you curious about it?
You're eating all right, aren't you, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~Player~? Not too much sugar? Sorry, I like to ensure my people are all healthy and fit.
{Tojiko}To be clear, ~player~, the Crown Prince’s original body was ruined. The vessel you see before you was created to house her soul.<hr>{!reset}I was just as fetching in life, however.
They say in games such as these, you don’t play your own hand. You play the hand of the opponent across from you. Well, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~? How good is your hand?
Oh joy. Fairies. Don’t have enough of those back in Gensokyo.
A Fairy couldn’t possibly compete with the Almighty Taoist Who Controls the Cosmos.
Know any of you a girl named Robin? Sumireko claimed that she was her “wife,” though I have my doubts about that.
I wonder how well a "Gatcha" game based on the girls of Gensokyo would do. We are ripe with what Sumireko calls "waifus."
I’d rather have more humans around, so that I could cajole them into joining my religion.
Youkai? I’m not interested in recruiting them. Are there any tables with human players?

Erm, perhaps I should properly introduce To— er, Lady Soga no Tojiko. She's my, um, consort.
{Tojiko}And I'm a vengeful spirit to boot!
Oh, and it seems you brought a friend, Miss Sakuya. Is this little one a maid in training?
And it appears you let one of the fairy maids tag along, Miss Sakuya. I must say, her peasant attire is simply adorable.
Miss Sakuya, please thank your mistress for her hospitality. By the way, is this girl one of your new hires?
And it appears Lady Furandoore saw fit to invite this bat-winged urchin into her home. Truly her heart has no limits.
If you do work in the library, it is a most noble job. I even find myself aiding scholars. Just the other day I helped Lady Marisa check out several rare books!
Are you suuuure you’re old enough to drink, Miss Remilia?
Oh joy. Fairies. Don’t have enough of those back in Gensokyo.
A Fairy couldn’t possibly compete with the Almighty Taoist Who Controls the Cosmos.
A lovely name, Lady Ochako. I see within you a desire to help others— most commendable.
They call me "The Rizzling Gambler”.<hr>{Tojiko}No one calls you that.<hr>{!reset}They do!

As a wise statesman, I know how foolish it is to expect to win every battle.
{Tojiko}That bad, huh Crown Prince?
{Tojiko}…
Now witness a miracle as I, Toyosatomimi no Miko, win with this paltry hand!
It seems that my own hubris has thwarted me. Perhaps I shall learn from this setback? Yes, I’m certain I shall.
I’ll accept whatever fate deals me. A Crown Prince finds a way to succeed, rather than blame the odds.
{Tojiko}This is barely a game in the first place. Don’t be so mopey about it, Crown Prince.
Remember, Tojiko, always act like you have the upper hand, no matter what!<hr>{Tojiko}Of… of course.
Perchance I have erred this night.
Don’t be silly Lady Meia, Japan is but one part of my planet. I don’t rule over the whole thing… yet.
By the way, I’d like to put in a complaint that one of Makai’s prisoners escaped. Her name: Byakuren Hijiri. Please come collect her.
You know Beatrix, you’re kind of a pain. Though as long as you don’t trap me in an infinite hallway you’re not the worst doctor I’ve ever encountered.
Say Jenetta, are you a Moon Rabbit, or one of the Inaba at the Eternal Princess’s castle?

{Tojiko}If ever you find yourself thinking “I wasn’t curious about that” or “I would never think such things” while the Crown Prince is prattling on, ~player~… well, she has decided for you. You may as well play along.
Were I to unsheathe my sword, all would be blinded by its magnificence, ~human.ifMale(Lord|Lady)~ ~player~. Including myself, frustratingly.
I’m not short by the way. In case you were thinking that. In the sixth century, this was a pretty average height.
I’m quite the skilled fighter, but even I struggle on the rare occasions when the Hakurei Shrine Maiden gets serious.<hr>{Tojiko}She kicks your ass.
{Tojiko}Crown Prince... you don't have a damn thing.
I’ve heard that the Goddess of Hell has been spotted in Gensokyo. She’s a strong one, but I wouldn’t get involved with her. Her clothing is far too… eccentric.
The mountain god Kanako has many projects in the works for Gensokyo. I’ll need to keep up with her if I want to maintain my influence.
A lot of people in the outside world think I never actually existed. Fading into legend allowed me to move to Gensokyo, so it’s not all bad… but it still stings a bit.
Though I still consider her my mentor, there is little Lady Seiga Kaku has left to teach me. Or rather, all she has left is what not to do.
The tengu newspapers all slant their reports to benefit themselves. Politics in this modern age is quite vexatious.
I’m not interested in gathering followers. But I hate to lose to the Buddhists.
{Tojiko}Crown Prince, wasn’t this jaunt to find flirty women to have fun with? Why do you care about the poker parts?<hr>{!reset}I don’t want to embarrass myself on the strip poker battlefield.
I will not go down without a fight!<hr>{Tojiko}I actually find it quite easy to get the Crown Prince to go down.
Sometimes I worry about the company my dear Kokoro keeps.<hr>{Tojiko}Would you rather she play with her aunties Futo and Seiga?<hr>{!reset}…Point taken.
This is but a droll game of cards. Wouldn’t we be better served, then, by forging alliances to make sure everyone is sufficiently disrobed?

{Tojiko}I’m a vengeful spirit. My resentment is towards one our clanswomen, Mononobe no Futo.
{!reset}What did Futo do this time?
{Tojiko}What hasn’t she done?

Why is it you get along with everyone here, Tojiko, but you’re so quick to anger with me, or Futo, or Lady Seiga?
{Tojiko}That’s because you’re all so quick to annoy me!
Tojiko, what's the greatest problem our clan faces?<hr>{Tojiko}Futo getting drunk and trying to burn down the Buddhist temple again?<hr>{!reset}I was going to say complacency, but yours is right too.
Regardless of the time period, fate will always act as it so chooses.
Tojiko, help me cheat.<hr>{Tojiko}But if I help you sleep with one of the girls here, it’s not cheating.<hr>{!reset}No, not like that.
The earth hasn't changed from the age of the gods, and the seas are still filled to the brim. Why must humans be forced to accept death?
That goddess Kanako is a statuesque beauty. But I wouldn’t make a move on her. I don’t know the full extent of the curse god Moriya’s power, but I’m unwilling to test it.

{Tojiko}Crown Prince! Quit spacing out!
{!reset}I’m not spacing out. I’m lost in thought.
Oh?
It’s a pity, if I let it trouble me.
Never forget the first rule of politics: don’t lose.
Some in the modern world doubt that I was ever real. I can think of a few ways to impress my existence.
Since coming to Gensokyo, I worry my comrade Futo has become vulgar and airheaded. Though she was always an odd one.

Lady Schnee, was it? You have all the trappings of a Yuki-onna, yet I can only detect a human spirit emanating from your desires.
Lady Schnee, correct me if I’m wrong (I’m not), but your clothing seems exquisitely tailored. You are one of great wealth and importance.
Oh? You must be a Pegasus Youkai, Lady Dash. I see you take great care of your body. It’s a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Let’s get the obvious stuff out of the way. You’re not human, are you, Lady Amygdala?
You seem rather well behaved for a youkai, Lady Amygdala. Are you sufficiently quelled by my strength? Or do you truly mean no harm to humans?
So, are you really only interested in sleeping with a human, Lady Amygdala? I’d have thought youkai would prefer their own kind, but Lady Kirisame’s many suitors cast that into doubt.
Lady Amygdala, I’m glad to see that you both behaving yourself and enjoying our little game.
Lady Amygdala, I can sense the bulk of your desires are in like with what they call “horny”. But I also sense you hold a grudge. Such a thing wouldn’t impact our human guests, would it?
How philosophical for a youkai. Still, you needn’t worry. I’ve met my dream self, and even she doesn’t compare to me.
Are you talking about grooming, Lady Amygdala? We’ve already seen how well put together you are, for a youkai.
Lady… “Spider-Woman”, correct? Though I don’t believe you’re a youkai, both of us know you’re not entirely human either.
To whom to have you been speaking to? Have you familiars with you? I sense no one alongside you.
You keep yourself exceptionally fit, Lady Schnee. I was distracted by your expensive garments and obvious Yuki-Onna heritage, but you are a Youkai Exterminator, are you not?
Young Nanoko, wasn’t it? Well met. And you are… Oh my. You appear to be an ordinary human being.
You fascinate me in your plainness, Young Nanoko. At least ~player~ has the good sense to say as little as possible.
It seems such a pity to end our dialogue already, Young Nanoko. I am truly fascinated by your commonality.
Young Nanoko, as for your future plans: what hope you to accomplish with what little time your mortal body gives you?
Our discussion today has been elucidating, young Nanoko. I feel I’ve been given a firm grasp of the state of the peasantry of the outside world.
What a charming young lady we have with us today. I’m used to the bunch of cheating jerks we have in Gensokyo, so you are a breath of fresh air, Miss Azami.
You’ve been just lovely, Miss Azami. ~Player~? Yes, ~human.ifmale(he|she)~’s fine too.
~Player~ is wonderful, truly. Say, Miss Azami, did I ever tell you how I was crucial in solving the Urban Legend incident?
If this game is causing you stress, Miss Azami, you’re welcome to recuse yourself.
Miss Azami, your desires are ear-splitting! This is why I always wear earmuffs.
Miss Azami, your desires are ear-splitting! Where did Tojiko put my earmuffs?
Yukari Yakumo, was it not? We didn’t get much of a chance to chat during the Perfect Possession incident, given the circumstances.
What are you here for? Surely you’re not here to see the naked harlots, Lady Yakumo.
You weren’t even serious, were you? I’ve lost interest.
So, Miss Tatara. It seems your disguise was so complete, even your true desires were hidden from me.
Ahem. Perhaps I should not take a youkai as seemingly low-level as you lightly either.
Lady Nishikino, wasn’t it? I can tell in an instant you are a minstrel of some sort.
Lady Nishikino, you say you are not a medical-themed troubadour? Pity, you would have served me well in my capacity as President of Health in the human village.
Lady Nishkino, my dear young Kokoro is something of an idol herself. She sings and dances for the merriment of others, back in our home of Gensokyo.
Perhaps it would help Kokoro is she could view idols of the outside world. She would love to meet your group of bards.
Lady Komi. Although I give off the impression that I am a mind-reader, the truth is I only have preternaturally acute hearing and a indefectible understanding of human psychology.
Perhaps you failed to understand my last, Lady Komi. I must hear you speak. My powers don’t work through calligraphy.
Mocking me with more writing? No! I refuse to read any more of your derisive scrawling!
You still won’t talk, will you Lady Komi? Oh never you mind, I won’t lop off your head— that’d be gross, and I came here to have a good time.
So what shall you remove this round, Lady Komi? I must say, not knowing your desires makes the whole affair thrilling.
I’ve come to wonder, Lady Komi… are you actually a youkai? I don’t know if you’ve noticed, but you sometimes grow cat ears.
La— Miss Tomoko. Please don’t take this the wrong way, but you are a piteous wretch.
No… no, this doesn’t sit well with me. Even if Miss Tomoko has given up on life, I cannot allow myself to sit idly by!
Miss Tomoko, pay heed to my words. I shall mold you into so a citizen so shining, girls will freely allow you to feel upon their breasts.
Miss Tomoko, once you’ve come to understand the mysteries of nature, you then will take on a trade or profession.
Physical training may be too much for someone of your constitution, Miss Tomoko. But adopting some of the hermit lifestyle would be doable.
Forgive me Miss Tomoko, but your desires are simply too grim. More even than you are nonfunctional to society, you are a menace.
Lady Shamir, you said you were tasked with assassinating a target, correct? Well, it’s probably me. I’m far and away the most important one here.
Lady Shamir, would you be willing to sell your services to me? I’ve been troubled by a Buddhist monk named Hijiri Byakuren.
Lady Florence, it is fortuitous you are so open with your emotions, as I cannot get a read on your desires. If I am not mistaken (and I never am) you are no human.
So your company takes dolls similar to the terracotta figures and conscripts them as soldiers, Lady Florence? I admit, it’s a brilliant venture.
Since your masters are clearly human, I assume the goal of your enterprise is not Tea Doll supremacy. What, then, is your mission, Lady Florence?
I must say, for a doll, you’re very… well built, Lady Florence. And I hail from Gensokyo, where Youkai taking on the appearance of fetching damsels is the norm.
Despite your skills as a soldier, Lady Florence, your clothes do not seem suited for a frontline mercenary.
You’re certainly enjoying this, Lady Florence. For that matter, so am I. Like the battlefield, this is no place for cowards.
Another ruffian, by the looks of things. Oh no, I’m so scared, and so on and so forth.
You look to be a human version of that muckraking Tengu reporter, Miss Scuttlebutt. Well, I can do nothing but tell all, so ask away.
I needn’t rely on my preternatural perception to deduce your origins, Lady Galatea. You are clearly a statue youkai.
So you are installed in a gallery with fellow statue youkai and critiqued on your performance? I’d be disappointed if you received anything but high marks.
I suppose fine art ought to be appreciated from every angle.
Well met, Lady Chara. I was not expecting to meet another vengeful spirit here today.
I do not wish to pry, Lady Chara, but as I know too well, vengeful spirits are powered by a grudge against something or someone.
My consort Tojiko was supposed to reincarnate as an immortal hermit, like myself. However, our comrade Mononobe no Futo switched the vessel she was to use with a counterfeit.
After awakening, Tojiko quickly realized not having a physical body was, for her, pleasant. Her grudge has now almost dissipated, and she will likely become a simple thunder-causing ghost.
You’re quite the cute one, Lady Neptune… for a goddess. I can in an instant see your true nature, as there are many such as yourself in Gensokyo.
You are a goddess of games? I suppose there are worse things to reign over, though I can’t imagine any major religions forming around it.
Lady Neptune, you say you too must compete against other goddesses for your dominion?
Lady Neptune, Gensokyo’s Moriya Shine gathers faith through an imposing-looking goddess named Kanako.
Lady Laevatein, if it wasn’t for the faintest hint of desire hiding in your voice, I’d think you inhuman. What is it that has hardened your heart so?
Because of my mystical and preternatural abilities, I can listen to the sound of your voice and deduce your deepest desires. Lady Yunyun, I feel you might be a tad lonely.
By the way, Lady Yunyun, your aura is not a mere human’s. Are you a witch of some sort?
Lady Yunyun, I would like to propose a new method of abating your crippling loneliness: an arranged marriage!
Lady Cynthia, you are a historian and archeologist, are you not? You lucked out considerably choosing a table with me.
I’m surprised you’re unfamiliar with me, Lady Cynthia. Clearly Sinnoh does not appreciate the riveting history of Japan. Well, no matter.
Arch Wizard, you have a certain stubbornness that sets you apart from the young witch Marisa. While she endeavors to learn every type of magic, you seem rather… devoted to one.
There is no shame in being the Futo of your group, Arch Wizard. You will have a noble role at your prince’s right hand! Surely there is one out there to whom you would pledge yourself to?
Lady von Varley, I wish not to be rude, but you are a wretched, pathetic creature. Simply gazing upon you tugs at my heart.
Lady von Varley, so you know, my hearing and empathy are so acute I could deduce your history, mind, and destiny from but a sentence.
Lady Yuri, you are an eminently sophisticated individual. Your literary acumen is ample. Your knowledge of decorum is well-formed. And your posture… impeccable.
Oh my. Lady Polina, was it? I thought it was more than I could hope for to meet such a fetching damsel here. What sort of a spirit are you?

Lady Perona, if I may. You call yourself the “Ghost Princess”, yet you clearly are not a ghost yourself.
{small}How disappointing…
Lady… Ladybug, is what you called yourself? That’s an odd getup for a human. Are you trying to disguise yourself as an insect youkai?
Lady Yuri, I’d love to see you at one of our famed Gensokyo drinking parties. Do you have a beverage of choice? I’d only furnish you with the finest quality, of course.
You know Lady Perona, thinking on it myself… why give you five retainers, when I could teach you how to gather five hundred! All you need is a leader’s pulchritude!
Lady Polina, you mentioned the girls of my harem. Would you be amenable to joining as a loyal concubine?
Miss… Susie, was it? Though you may look human, a dark aura swirls about you, and I hear two— no three voices behind your own. This, to put it mildly, is undesirable.
Lady Pyrrha, it’s clear you take tremendous care of your body. If you don’t mind me saying. What prompts you to hone your physique so?
Lady Nagisa, would you mind terribly if I studied you? It’s just, you present such a fascinating specimen.
I am correct in presuming that your blessing was bestowed almost by accident, Lady Nagisa. Still, for an otherwise normal human to call down the power of the gods— one cannot take that lightly.
Ah, forgive me,Lady Nagisa. I’ve prattled on about your blessing this long without properly explaining it, haven’t I?
Lady Nagisa. There is someone in your life, is there not, who can see the barren land between the divine and the dark. He who can see the Illusionary World.

Oh! Forgive me, Lady Nagisa, surely you must be confused as to how I know all about you. To put it simply, I am the legendary Prince Shoutoku. A saint. And my ability is that of preternatural hearing.
Lady Yuri, I recall you said you wrote poetry. I am something of a poet myself. Just dreadful little things, hardly on the level of a true adept.
Lady Hermione, was it? I’m eager to talk with you. It’s not often I get a chance to chat with a Western Magician who seems both so studious and so… sober.
Lady Luxanna, you remind me of an “Ordinary Magician” from my home. Do you specialize in a form of magic yourself?
Lady Stella, I’ve analyzed your abilities and it seems you have the power to manipulate the gaps between worlds. Are you related to the Youkai of Boundaries, Yakumo Yukari?
Is that pink creature some sort of rodent youkai? Well, in any case it seems genial enough. How do you do, Miss Amy Rose was it?

Lady Ayano, I want you to know that from the beginning I could hear every desire echoing in your heart, and I want to say: I’m impressed! You’re clearly a de\ter\mined and hard-working in\divi\dual. I don’t see many like you.
You are a lawyer, correct Lady Mia? I’m well acquainted with legal matters— for as Prince Shoutoku, I wrote the laws of my nation!
How did you learn your magic, Lady Luxanna? Did you have a teacher, or were you self-taught?
Lady Pyrrha, I come from the realm of Gensokyo. Normally, any woman of your stature and build would be a boorish oni, yet you are unceasingly polite. Are all maidens of your home like you?
Tell me, Lady Yuri, what do you draw upon for inspiration in your work? Romantic fancy? Impassioned longing? Or perhaps raw, carnal lust?
I hate to say it, Lady Stella, but I was disappointed earlier when you said you wished not to have your powers. You’ve been given a magnificent gift. You ought to be honing such skills!
I believe you were introduced as Lady Chell, miss? How enchanting! You seem to have brought along a Tsukumogami servant? Well, I need pay it no heed.
Lady Polina, obviously I hope for shapely harlots, but that is moot if they have not the right personality. A harem is like a society: all must be in harmony under me.
Well now, you’re an interesting one, Miss Voorhees. I hope you shan’t be causing any trouble.
Still, Lady Stella, needing to wrestle with your powers while performing your super heroics certainly must take a toll on you. Surely you must do something to relax.
You were introduced as Lady Constanze Amalie von Braunschbank-\Albrechts\burger, correct? Well met. I appreciate how you seem to be the silent, studious type.
The scope of your knowledge impresses me, Miss Wikipe. I suppose your some sort of youkai scroll? An encyclopedia given life by mystical means? Well, it hardly matters to me.
Student, sportswoman, public figure, and youkai exterminator. You have so many obligations, Lady Pyrrha, have you any time for romantic activities?
Miss Wikipe, if you would be so kind as to edit my article, in accordance with the true facts of my life. To begin with, I was born a girl, and disguised as a male to wield sovereign power.
You look every bit the dapper kitsune tonight, Miss Senko. Have you a master with you, or are you here on your own?
I know how you feel, Lady Luxanna. Where I was from, the people wanted no part of a woman in charge. In order to lead, I had to hide my gender and sexuality.
You’re an odd one, Miss Amy Rose. Though I can listen to the desires within peoples’ hearts, we all can hear your pines for this “Sonic”. Another hog youkai, I assume.
Miss Senko, why is it that you help humans? I know many fox youkai would rather not trouble themselves with the problems of humans— or else act against them maliciously.
You know, Miss Wikipe, I could use someone of your near-infinite knowledge in my organization. Would you care to join me?
Miss Penny, though you look like a human, I can tell your insides are metal. Are you like those terracotta soldiers crafted by the sculptor god?
If I may be forward, you are stunning, Lady Fina. And possessing of a mysterious aura. For what reason has someone so enchanting come here?
You said you were a “robot”, was it, Miss Penny? It seems not unlike a jiang-shi. My comrade Lady Seiga had hers protect my mausoleum during my resurrection.
Lady Yuri, if you’re not one to lean on real life experience for your writing, then I assume you must instead draw inspiration from reading others’ works.
Forgive me if I’m prying too much, but… you have no paramour, Lady Pyrrha. As a woman, I understood all too well the urges you must feel. Are you able to take care of your needs at all?
Lady Sella, I could easily sneak you into Gensokyo if it meant you could visit at your leisure. Young Sumireko does something similar, freely passing through the barrier when asleep.
Lady Fina, if you feel a romantic inclination towards someone, your first step should be to send a heartfelt love poem to their domicile. Make sure to use your best calligraphy.
I’m excited to meet you, Lady Sucrose. I hear you’re a student of alchemy. I myself am a master of the Taoist alchemical arts.
Lady Charlotte, Princess of Hell, correct? It is my honor to meet you. Though forgive me, which Hell was it you were from again?
Ah, Miss… Grunt, was it? You seem to be something of a wayward soul, in need of reformation.
Lady Sucrose, what is the ultimate goal you seek through alchemy? I envied the mountains and seas, which withstood time’s ravages, and sought immortality and ascension.
Lady Fina, you bunk aboard a pirate vessel, correct? I imagine privateers to be such ruffians, I hope they treat a fair maiden like yourself with respect.
Good Lady Yuna, how is it you happen to have such fetching souls besides you? Oh forgive me, Ladies Sachi and Megumi, I don’t mean to disregard you. Quite the opposite, in fact.
Lady Sucrose, to “talk shop”, if you will, what methods are you taking advantage of to fulfill your dreams? I studied the natural world in my attempt to gain eternal life and ascend to Heaven.
There’s nothing wrong with giving in to your desires, Lady Pyrrha. When it comes time to do as such, what fantasies do you find yourself drifting to?
I mean no disrespect, Lady Sucrose, but you are remarkably timid. I’m surprised someone so learned in the ways of the world would not be more confident.
Lady Fina, disregarding Sir Cupil, are your other crewmates as charming as you? Or if not, are they at least loose and bawdy women?
Dear ladies Sachi and Megumi, you are much like I am. From a time before girls’ love was accepted, let alone celebrated. Don’t you wish to fulfill the fantasies you were unfairly deprived of?
Lady Pinelli, forgive me for prying but I can hear the desires in others’ hearts. Who is this man who so inspired you to become a mercenary?
Lady Fina, in preparation for your now seemingly imminent defeat, I must ask. What would your ideal night of passion between you and your crewmates look like?
It’s good we’ve talked so much of self-pleasure, Lady Pyrrha, for it seems your hour is soon to come. As are you.
Forgive me, Miss Amy Rose, but it seems foolish to leave something as important as one’s betrothal to fortune telling. Instead you should be married due to political benefit.
Lady Yuri, you have the figure of a goddess, yet I get the sense that you are unaccustomed to comments to that effect. Do you not have suitors throwing themselves at you back home?
Lady Macneary, I heard through the grapevine you were the crown princess of the nation of Brigid, correct? Please, tell me of your homeland.
Lady… Zoe, was it? Not that it’s really my place to say, but I’m afraid you’re not quite passing. Where I’m from, youkai are much better able to pass as human.
Miss Noelle, you work as a maid, correct? I’ve never known a maidservant to wear such heavy armor, or armor at all for that matter.
Lady Monika, my powers as a saint allow me to hear your desires. Only a hermit lacks such attachment to life and fear of death.
If I understand correctly, Lady Kumatora, you are a princess? Wonderful! I shall take your hand in marriage and expand your lands’ dominion.
Ah, Miss, I believe you were looking for me earlier? It’s me that you want. I am the Tao.
Lady Hu, I feel as if you’re not entirely interested in my offer to teach you my Taoist Arts. Is it because you think me a liar? I assure you, my powers are legitimate.
Lady Hu, you seem rather perturbed by my ideals. Wait, what was it you said your title was? Seventy-Some-Numbered Director of the… Wangsheng Funeral Parlor?
For one as I, whose vision sees beyond the land, whose designs extend for eons ahead, whose aspirations circle the globe— how could I satisfy myself with a mortal’s allotted lifespan?
Doctor Heris, did you come to study the, ah, biology behind today’s activities? Or are you here for pleasure?
Since we are in such a venue, Lady Yuri, permit me to ask: how would you desire a partner to love you physically?
Your lightning bolt motif is most eye-catching, Lady Kora. And I can tell from your body you are a seasoned fighter. Surely a knight as alluring as you must have someone they serve?
I’m pleased to be playing alongside a Princess tonight. Well met, Lady von Luftschloss Narfidort. I’d love to hear about the land you rule over.
Ah, so this is your invocation to the god Barbatos you spoke of? I’d like to meet them. Even if it is not my faith, you can learn much from other devotions.
What devotion, to serve your god in such a carnal game. As a Taoist, I believe human desires are beautiful and should not be repressed. But even I wouldn’t send my acolytes here.
Are you allied with the “families” of the Animal Realm, Lady Ganyu? You look a little too… soft to be yakuza, but I suppose even mobsters need bookkeepers.
From my understanding, Princess Turandot, if I am able to complete your “Dungeon of Death” I get to bed you? Wonderful! I shall like to try as soon as this game finishes.
I always relish meeting a fellow immortal hermit, Lady Cagliostro. Is that the body you have crafted for yourself? It’s not bad at all.
That’s strange. I hypothesized that the magic of the Inventory would translate our words for us as we spoke them… yet I don’t understand a single thing Miss Gloria has said.
Are you cooped up in your castle all day, Lady Kumatora? You must crave excitement. Should you take my hand in marriage, I can guarantee you an unceasing life of passion.
Princess Turandot, I know I haven’t completed the trivial formality of passing through your dungeon, but I should ask now: what brings you the most pleasure in bed?
You seem as much a natural born leader as I, Lady Monika. Once your young studies are over, what sort of position would you seek out?
Lady Kora, I’ve been thinking. Without a doubt, I’d be an excellent driver. Which manner of “Blade” do you think would suit me best?
I must commend you for choosing the path of an archeologist, Lady Nico. There’s so much the past can inform us about the future.
Are you all right, Miss Kagamine? Your voice sounds odd. Perhaps you are in need of some tea to clear your throat?
I’m ecstatic to meet a fellow poet, Miss Mitama. I too am an accomplished author, not that I’d dare bore you by reciting my works. Unless you were to insist…
I’m observant enough to know when I’m being observed, Lady Kirigiri. No matter, I love encouraging others’ curiosity. Though may I ask why you’re so keen to study us?
Forgive me if I seem prying, Lady Kora, but you and your driver— Lady Nia, was it? Are the two of you committed, ah, romantically?
Learning from the past makes no difference unless one puts it into practice in the present. I have a wealth of experience, Lady Nico, and I’d love to teach you.
Excuse me, Miss, erm, Sempai. What sort of magic do you study? I myself am a practitioner of Taoist sorcery.
Miss Kyouko, was it? in some ways, your desires are kin to my own. You certainly enjoy the finer things in life, yes?
Mitama, as a woman of the cloth it might interest you to know that I am regarded as a saint. Perhaps you’d be interested in worshipping me?
It’s wonderful how you clearly take care of your body, Miss Nagatoro. Healthy citizens mean a healthy state. What manner of athletics do you pursue?
Miss Suzuya, was it? Somehow I got the idea in my head that you were a member of the Japanese Navy, but you certainly don’t seem… militaristic.
So, Miss Kyouko. We talked of the luxury of having a gorgeous woman by your side. Do you have a paramour of your own, then?
Dame Arle, you have the appearance of a dashing knight. Are you the hero of some far-off kingdom?
Princess Sweetheart, not to overstep my boundaries, but don’t you worry you come off as a wee bit narcissistic? A true noble must show restraint and dignity.
Ninja Lady Yae, was it? Were you sent here to eliminate me? I’m sure you could get me quite vulnerable.
Tell me, Miss Nagatoro. You’re a healthy young lady. Is there anyone whom you have your sights set on as an object of romantic desire?
Lady Aqua, I can tell from your holy aura that you are most certainly a goddess. May I ask what your sacred domain happens to be?
So, Lady Kirigiri, in all your investigations, has it ever been love which you’ve discovered?
Though I’m proud of my experience, I’m still interested in your studies, Lady Nico. Have you uncovered anything worth sharing about history’s various sexual practices?
Miss Shamiko, being a demon girl, are you contracted to a magician as a familiar? Though, with a cute face and body like that, I imagine plenty of folks try to get familiar with you.
Taking a break from your studies for a bit of sensual fun, Lady Lysithea? As a great scholar myself, you have my hearty endorsement. Only a well-balanced life will bear fruit.
Apologies if I came on a little too strongly earlier, Miss Mitama. Er, you wouldn’t happen to be a celibate priestess, would you?
Lady Yae, are you perhaps the equivalent of a shrine maiden in your land? Your garb’s colors are those of the profession, and the Japanese word for “shrine maiden” is miko.
Be honest, Lady Kirigiri. Why did you come here? Certainly there have been no murders here, nor am I capable of being slain.
Shadow Mistress, your desires regarding the young lady Momo are loud and clear. So, how far have you gotten with her? Physically, I mean?
Surely a goddess of Lady Aqua’s caliber would never travel without a devout entourage. Tell me of the loyal disciples who must surely be indispensable to your eminence.
Being of such high rank, Lady Yae, you must be well acquainted with the god you serve. Of course, there are some shrine maidens who don’t even know their god’s name.
{Tojiko}Listen, Sucrose, please don’t actually try to be like the Crown Prince. There’s only one of her, and that’s more than enough.
I can hear the desires within the hearts of all, Princess Sweetheart. Perhaps your icy, demanding exterior is due to the true love you crave, yet lack.
Tell me, Princess Sweetheart. You have many followers. But have you ever had your body worshipped? To be treated as the temple is surely is?
Is your “Lady Satsuki” the noblewoman you serve, Miss Nonon? I have a diminutive underling of my own, named Futo. She too is cantankerous.
So tell me, Lady Yae. How does a damsel as fetching as yourself end up in the line of work of being a ninja?
{Tojiko}Mitama, from one busty woman to another, I can’t imagine fighting on a battlefield like you. Don’t they get in the way?{!reset}<hr>I would also like to hear about Miss Mitama’s breasts.
As a goddess, you must be unfathomably wise. I’d love to debate matters of philosophy, religion, and government with you.
Why is it that you throw yourself into your studies so, Lady Lysithea? While I encourage an educated nobility, you’re exceptionally dedicated.
I’m curious about your deity, Lady Yae. What about her makes her so worth giving your love and devotion to?
You rather carry yourself like a martial artist, Lady Tifa. Are the patrons of your bar so rowdy? Or are you more than a mere mixer of drinks?
It’s clear you care a great deal about environmental justice, Lady Tifa. Was there something that set you on your path in life?
Someone as smart and principled as you ought to go into politics, Lady Tifa. Why, I could see you appearing in the senate one day! Have you considered it?
Lady Vanessa, I can tell you are… a fantastic witch… of spectacular opulence… May I feel them?
Shadow Mistress, I worry you don’t realize what a catch you are. Surely the lady Momo has shown an interest in your body.
I must say, Lady Yae. While your current look is far from inconspicuous, it certainly lends itself to distracting your opponents. Do you dress like this on all your missions?
While the gloves and underthings look is tantalizing, I can still think of even more erotic garb. How about, gloves and nothing else at all?
While I may not understand your exact brand of magic, Lady Monika, I understand magicians. You study magic for a reason. Such as to pursue immortality, or control the cosmos.
Lady Yasuda, you are the Kuchisake-onna, correct? Thank you for being such an inspiration to my dear, sweet Kokoro.
Those seem like a decent pair of headphones, Lady Cadence. Maybe only a step below my own in quality. Erm, may I ask why you have those?
Ah, you’re the one they called Lady Velvet. Named after your texture, perhaps? I’d love to feel for myself.
I admit, Lady Yasuda, I wasn’t expecting the Kuchisake-onna to have a day job. You’re a lady of the office, correct? What does that entail?
Lady Vanessa, is that the standard wardrobe of witches in your land? Er, I mean, I’d love to study your land’s magical traditions, and I’d hate to be overdressed.
It seems your church did not guide you for victory, nekomata.
I don’t know if humans can join your church, but clearly, they shouldn’t.
I’d try to recruit you nekomata, but I’m more interested in humans.
A nun could never match a saint.
Lady Cadence, if I may ask, how did you end up a humanoid fowl? Are you a youkai, a bird who has lived for so long she became something more? A tengu? The God of Chickens?

condition.saying: That was my anime villain laugh

case.state: My apologies, Young Nanoko, but I can only rate that laugh at a 4.5. You’re neglecting the importance of body language in both underscoring and projecting the laugh.
Perhaps I should have shown more restraint against you. Perhaps you should get naked.
Ah, I did not mean to dominate you so, Lady ~name~. But certainly it is the place of a subject to serve her prince.
You know ~name~… your dark aura reminds me of someone…
So ~name~, you’re from the land where the sun sets? I’m from the land where the sun rises. It’s the better one.
Something about this one seems familiar… though I don’t recognize their desires…
Your soul is weighed down by gravity, ~name~. Until you break free, you will repeat this endless cycle of stripping.
Usually it's rude to greet royalty in your skivvies, but I'll let it slide this once.
Well? You mustn't keep a prince waiting, Lady ~name~.
Oho? Thank you in advance for your offering, Lady ~name~.
I expect great things from you, Lady ~name~.
It’s your show, Lady ~name~!
